# Blooming Staging and Design

> Blooming Staging and Design is a Colorado home staging and interior design studio.
> We help real estate agents sell homes faster and for more, and help homeowners
> create elegant, timeless, and accessible spaces. Founded by Liliya Zelem and
> Amanda Boucher. Brand values: Elegant, Timeless, Accessible, Professional.

## Services

- [Home Staging](https://www.bloomingstaginganddesign.com/services/home-staging): Vacant and occupied home staging with a full inventory of furniture and accessories. Professionally staged homes sell faster and for up to 15% more.
- [Interior Design](https://www.bloomingstaginganddesign.com/services/interior-design): Single-room refresh to whole-home redesign, available as consultation-only or full implementation.
- [Color Consultation](https://www.bloomingstaginganddesign.com/services/color-consult): Expert paint palette selection matched to your light and finishes.
